name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px solid focus ring at 5:1 contrast with no glow or animation. This meets WCAG 2.1 AA for focus visibility while keeping the interface clean and predictable. The trade-off is slightly less visibility for users who need stronger contrast, but it balances accessibility with minimal visual clutter.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 5:1 contrast fails users with low vision or glare sensitivity—WCAG 2.1 AA is the *minimum*, not the ceiling. Use a 6px ring at 7:1 contrast instead; test with real screen-reader users on mobile and glare-heavy backgrounds to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 6px solid focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow or animation. This meets WCAG 2.1 AAA for focus visibility and handles glare, low vision, and touch targets better. The trade-off is a bolder ring that some users may find visually heavier, but accessibility isn’t about perfect aesthetics—it’s about usable interfaces for everyone.

name: Reader
text: A 6px ring at 7:1 contrast risks blending into busy or patterned backgrounds—especially on mobile where glare and small screens reduce perceived contrast. Test a 5px ring at 6:1 contrast instead; settle it by measuring focus visibility with real screen-reader users on glare-heavy backgrounds and mobile touch targets.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 5px solid #005fcc focus ring at 6:1 contrast with no animation; deliver a tested, glare-resistant focus style for mobile and screen-reader users; Ramp owns the artifact.
